node.title: Sharpen the transfer range: recompute the norm-height bound with explicit constants
node.statement: Re-derive the split-prime transfer's height bound exp(C n log n / sigma) with the sharpest explicit C (archimedean conjugate bounds (2l')^{N'/2} per level); determine the TRUE exponent shape (is N' log l' achievable in place of n log n?). Every constant improvement is direct range progress.
